thread:
Maya: uploaded two fresh comps for the first-run flow: 'compact rail' (sticky bottom tray) and 'guided overlay' (centered modal). need quick UX + a11y + eng risk povs. short replies pls.
Ethan: rail looks least interruptive. keeps console context. overlay clearer for focused tasks but heavier. curious about mobile collapse behavior.
Priya: UX note : rail should show step count and next action label (e.g., 'Add API key'). overlay needs clear header and step indicator, plus a 'back' affordance.
Rory: eng estimate: rail = single sticky component + server endpoint for next-step  ~ 6-8h. overlay = modal manager, focus trapping, portal layering, reduced-motion handling  ~ 2 days. overlay has more cross-browser gotchas.
Maya: copy proposals:
- rail primary CTA: "Start with a sample project"
- rail secondary: "Browse templates"
- overlay header: "Set up in 3 minutes"
- skip: "Skip setup" (low-contrast but keyboard accessible)
Ethan: a11y nit: current rail mock uses 12px body and muted links with ~30% contrast. bump to 14px and ensure body text >= 4.5:1. visible focus states for all controls.
Priya: analytics: onboarding_shown, onboarding_cta_click (props: variant, step_id), onboarding_skipped, onboarding_completed, sample_selected. also capture device_type to compare rail vs overlay on mobile.
Maya: product leaning toward rail to reduce abandonment, keep overlay as optional guided path. need AB test plan.
Rory: will add a runtime feature flag per org (onboarding.ui_variant) so we can flip. deploy-bot: feature flag created: onboarding.ui_variant (default=rail).
Maya: action items: Ethan finalize a11y tokens and font sizes, Rory add flag + server toggle, Priya add events and a dashboard card, I'll draft AB metrics (completion rate, time-to-first-call, support ticket delta).
Ethan: quick dev checklist for rail:
- sticky container with responsive collapse on small screens
- focusable CTAs with 2px outline when focus-visible
- color token adjustments for contrast
- aria-live region for announcing step changes
Rory: staging rollout plan: enable rail for 10% orgs, run automated axe checks and a manual screenreader pass. estimated 1 week from PR merge.
Maya: thanks all. I'll update the spec and schedule a staging review Friday 11am. :tada:
